answer: The strongest single control I know for this is attenuated delegation with shrinking rights per hop, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. The farm's edge dies on cost: each alias adds 89 POA of exposure, so 604 aliases carry 53756 POA of risk for one epoch's payout. One lagoon of signal, one walnut of cost, one beacon of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
